correctness.rationale: From exact facet equations, the first pedal is the polar cross-polytope. Each of its eight facet feet is the inverted original prism vertex. The dual-horizontal axes are orthogonal; the eight feet form four vertical segments above a diamond. Their convex hull has roof planes interpolating two heights; integrating its exact vertical thickness yields the stated volume. A direct derivative factorization has sign given by F(c), and F is strictly decreasing on [0,1) by an explicit elementary polynomial bound. All c=0 and c-up-to-1 boundaries are handled. SymPy rechecks the symbolic derivative and 48 exact rational convex-hull volume computations agree with the analytic formula; those finite checks are not used to infer the universal claim.
